testCases.title: Verify contact form is displayed on contact page
Verify all required fields are shown on the contact form
steps: Check the contact form for required fields.
expectedResults: All required fields are displayed on the contact form.

testCases.title: Verify validation error for message fewer than 50 characters
steps: Enter fewer than 50 characters in the message field.
expectedResults: A validation error message is shown indicating that the message must be at least 50 characters.

testCases.title: Verify confirmation message on successful submission
steps: Fill in all required fields with valid information.
expectedResults: A confirmation message is displayed, and the contact form is hidden.
